summary: Charlotte County, Florida tower near El Jobean; the listings give only its location and elevation, with no build date or history found.

evidence.quote: Frizzell Tower is listed in the Towers Category for Charlotte County in the state of Florida.

corrections.why: T40S R23E is a township and range, which is a location, not an agency. The Forest Lookouts page names no agency.

sources.title: Frizzell Tower Topo Map FL, Charlotte County (El Jobean Area)

notes_for_editor: Only location and elevation are sourced; no build date, staffing, fire or fate source was readable. Leads, not cited: (1) the Forest Lookouts page links a Waymarking listing (WM3F4W, El Jobean). fetch_text returns only its title; a search snippet from it names the Florida Department of Agriculture and Consumer Services as the placing agency, which needs checking. (2) Waymarking wm5MYW, a NOAA benchmark on this tower, appears in a search snippet to say the site is on US Forest Service property, which would conflict with a state placement. (3) Florida Memory item 326330 is titled as a Florida Forest Service observation tower; it returned 403. Anyplaceamerica and the 2004 Lakeland Ledger article on Florida towers also returned 403. Record coordinates (26.9723, -82.2088) sit about 230 m from TopoZone's point; left unchanged for a human to judge. Page reads went past the per-tower cap while looking for a history source.
